## About
Ramjet Rear End Repair was founded by Roger Paquette, who was a pioneer in the trade and kept finding new ways to work around a rear end. The shop has been part of the Valley ever since.
After Roger passed, Dave Reeves ran the business side while Eddie handled the mechanical work. Today Eddie runs Ramjet and leans on what both Roger and Dave taught him. As he puts it, every day is a new opportunity to learn.
Our goal is simple: build long lasting relationships with the people who bring us their trucks and cars. We think that is the only way to do the best work.

## Services
- Rear differentials: One reviewer brought her Jeep to Eddie when it needed a new rear differential.
- Seal work: One customer had a seal replaced and says it was done super quick.
- Drive shafts, u-joints and axle seals: Driveline work front to back, including drive shafts, u-joints and axle seals.

## FAQ
Q: What days are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Are you open on holidays?
A: No, the shop is closed on all major holidays.

Q: How do I get my vehicle looked at?
A: Get in touch to schedule an appointment with Eddie at the shop on Truman St. in San Fernando.

## What customers say
- "I can't say enough good things about Ramjet Rear End Repair and their honesty.

I called Ramjet about an issue with my truck's rear end. It had been rebuilt by another shop about two years ago, and about a week after getting it back, I noticed a slight jitter that seemed to slowly get worse over time. Thinking it was something else, I spent money replacing all of the U-joints, having the driveshaft balanced, and even getting an alignment. Despite all of that, the jitter continued and became especially noticeable when backing up slowly without touching the brakes.

When I explained everything to the gentleman at Ramjet, he asked me a simple question: "Did you go back and have the rear-end fluid changed after so many miles?" I told him no because nobody had ever mentioned that to me. He recommended I change the fluid first and only bring it in if the problem remained.

The same day, I changed the fluid, and WOW—the jitter was completely gone!

What impressed me most was his honesty. He could have easily told me to bring the truck in and spend a lot of money on diagnostics and repairs. Instead, he gave me straightforward advice that solved the problem immediately.

This truck belonged to my dad, who passed away in November 2025, so it's incredibly special to me. I've been doing everything I can to maintain it and keep it running right in his memory. I truly appreciate the time, knowledge, and integrity that Ramjet showed me.

Thank you, Ramjet, for your honesty and professionalism. You've earned my trust, and I'll be coming to you for any future rear-end or driveline work. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for knowledgeable people who genuinely want to help rather than just sell repairs." (ADOLF EGYED, 5/5)
